svg.text: claudia creates — grid and snap (branch grid-in-creates)
For review before any code: the View menu toggle, the live canvas while dragging, and the object's context menu in both states.
“Show grid” is new, grouped with the other canvas overlay (“Show who wrote what”).
On by default; a per-browser preference like Dark mode — not saved in the document.
B · Dragging, snapped to the grid
Default spacing: 50 units (32×18 cells on the 1600×900 slide). Snapping applies
to both moving and resizing; the dashed guide shows which lines the edges are caught on.
object's left and top edges caught on grid lines while dragging
C · Context menu — object is snapped
The default state of a new object.
The label swaps, the way Undo already reads
“Undo <what>” once there is something to undo.
Released an object from the grid
F · A released object ignores the grid
No guide line is drawn for it; it can rest at any position, mid-cell.
